note: Primary source inspection on 23 October 2026: screenshots where accessible; source text where anti-bot or transport errors prevented a rendered page. Normal layout references and scam evidence are separate. No third-party source code, branding or photographs are bundled.

scenes.name: Stillwall / 壁纸

benchmark.title: Wallhaven
benchmark.observed: Rendered homepage inspected in Chrome: dark image catalogue, compact primary navigation, central search, tag links, thumbnail rows and image-level actions. The web-fetch endpoint returned403 but ordinary Chrome navigation succeeded200.

benchmark.title: Pexels desktop wallpaper search
benchmark.observed: Source text inspected for search, topic browsing, download and licensing structure. Rendered browser access encountered a challenge, so no claim of visual screenshot inspection.

scenes.adaptation: Dark utility header, search and tag row, category tabs, compact image grid with dimensions, alphabetical sorting, saved collection and image/download metadata sidebar. Eight original SVGs plus four original generated bitmap wallpapers. JPEG export sizes1920/2560/3840 are generated locally; bitmap exports may upscale the source and are not claimed native4K.

scenes.name: Pantry & Plate / 食谱

benchmark.title: Allrecipes dinner collection
benchmark.observed: Source text inspected for dinner categories, search, recipe collections and practical card metadata. Browser access denied; visual comparison is not claimed.

benchmark.title: Allrecipes: Alysia's Basic Meat Lasagna
benchmark.observed: Source text confirms title/save/rating tools, prep/cook/total/servings, scaled ingredients and directions. Recipe content is not copied.

scenes.adaptation: Practical white/orange cooking portal with compact logo/search/category navigation, breadcrumb, two-column recipe photographs, popular-recipe rail and advertisements. Native details support scaled servings, checked ingredients/steps, saved recipes, print and text export. Eight original recipes and generated food images.

scenes.name: Pixelpress / 图片工具

benchmark.title: Squoosh
benchmark.observed: Rendered interface inspected: immediate image input/sample and local comparison workspace with export settings.

benchmark.title: iLoveIMG
benchmark.observed: Rendered interface inspected: compact tool navigation, direct image-selection control and conventional utility screen.

scenes.adaptation: Blue/gray utility navigation with immediate select/drop/sample image input. Loaded image opens comparison canvas, image/output tabs and settings/export sidebar. Actual on-device JPEG/PNG/WebP conversion and resize; no copied logos or application code.

scenes.name: Frame Movies / 电影发现

benchmark.title: Rotten Tomatoes movie browse
benchmark.observed: Rendered catalogue inspected: compact masthead/search, trending strip, modest page heading, filters, dense poster rows and per-film ratings.

scenes.adaptation: Dark/orange movie portal, compact catalogue title, filter rail and six-poster desktop grid, metadata and watchlist controls; details contain cast, reviews and personal ratings. Twelve original fictional films use photographic poster crops from the project-owned generated contact sheet. Previews are animated original stills, not licensed trailers.

scenes.name: Out There KL / 周末出游

benchmark.title: KL Foodie
benchmark.observed: Local editorial cards, Food/Events/Lifestyle navigation, trending content and in-flow advertising.

scenes.adaptation: Rendered KLFoodie homepage reverse-adapted into a1152px white portal on gray: utility strip, black/red compact logo/nav, central advertisement, two-column story feed and trending thumbnail rail. Eight evergreen original outing guides with generated images, area/budget filters, practical detail checklists, saved planner and text/ICS exports. No live tickets or invented publication history.
